validity_findings: Frozen design is internally consistent: spec.json, prereg.md, freeze.json, and design_review.json hashes are mutually consistent. The complete EXECUTE harness (run_experiment.py) sha256 28704cf16399e7117096dfb300ab230674a2cebd122d68a1620499f7c5d664da matches spec.design_satisfiability_probe.source_sha256 and the prereg BEGIN/END SBA-HARNESS block exactly.

All V1-V8 measurement validity gates pass in the scored run: V1_code_fidelity_manifest (harness sha256 + python 3.12.15 recorded), V2_transport_conformance (stdlib HTTP surface conformance), V3_no_leak (NC-NO-LEAK clean on all 7 protocol invariants), V4_determinism (two independent matrix passes byte-identical), V5_arm_liveness (T and PC at 1.0 all bands), V6_counter_instrumentation (all four counters on all cells), V7_matched_correctness (exact-match scoring, matched_correctness == success_rate everywhere), V8_ceiling_band (all arms 1.0 at novelty 0.0), V8_mechanism_off (NC-MECHANISM-OFF drives cold to 1.0).

The substrate is synthetic, credential-free, stdlib-only, generated entirely from frozen literals in spec.json (class_id SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2, derivations, endpoints, families, arms, controls, certificate arithmetic). No external dataset, credential, model, browser, or non-loopback network is used. server_secret is deterministic from run_seed with no secrets/clock/os.urandom.

The measured dynamic range is an engineered construction property: comparator success_rate = (K-1)/K because exactly one of K tasks per session (the chain task at novelty >= 0.50) requires the one-time session binding. This is not a claim about baseline strength on natural Web tasks. The certificate explicitly bounds the amortization rate, not agent capability (NC-MEMORYFUL disclosed boundary).

Scope is correctly bounded: one construction class (SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2), two families (F1-RECORDS K=8, F2-WIDGETS K=10) measured in the scored matrix. The K-sweep {6..12} is arithmetically in-band per the closed form but only K=8,10 were measured. No claim promotion occurs; C-MEAS-VALID substrate-validity evidence only.

EXECUTE cross-checks confirm reproducibility: EXECUTE probe-mode stdout sha256 equals DESIGN probe output_sha256 (023cc3e283ad50bb2828cd28bb857e1c735325b803f1f831f8bb964e6037ae77); EXECUTE selftest stdout sha256 equals DESIGN selftest_sha256 (7456fc3bbe95f0c60d3dca755b05b3cf99c4f0eaa7f1d733b3906c819e636931); two scored passes byte-identical (determinism_ok=true).

The repository scope guard reported SPIDER_CONTROL_OVERLAY_DIRTY from concurrent codex/control-plane writes outside this experiment's directory; frozen inputs are unmodified and the guard exits before evaluating lane paths. This is a control-plane concurrency condition, not an experiment-measurement condition, and does not affect validity.
baseline_findings: Positive control PC-EXACT-REPLAY: success_rate 1.0 at all 8 (family, novelty) cells for both families (160/160 F1, 200/200 F2). Matched_correctness 1.0. Counters match frozen predictions (F1: http_calls=17, verification_calls=8 per session; F2: http_calls=21, verification_calls=10). Passes V5 liveness gate.

Comparator B-COLD-RE-DERIVE: at novelty 0.0 and 0.25 success_rate 1.0 (ceiling band, chain mechanism not engaged). At novelty >= 0.50 success_rate exactly (K-1)/K: F1 140/160=0.875, F2 180/200=0.900. Repair_calls=1 per session at scored band (chain task fails, retries not implemented in cold policy). Counters per session: F1 http_calls=24, verification_calls=8, repair_calls=1; F2 http_calls=30, verification_calls=10, repair_calls=1. Matches frozen predictions exactly.

Comparator B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: identical success_rates to cold at all bands (stale foreign-session binding for chain task fails identically). Adds retrieval_calls=K per session (F1=8, F2=10). Counters per session at scored band: F1 http_calls=24, verification_calls=8, repair_calls=1, retrieval_calls=8; F2 http_calls=30, verification_calls=10, repair_calls=1, retrieval_calls=10. Matches frozen predictions.

Treatment T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY: success_rate 1.0 at all bands. Captures one-time binding from precursor receipt, uses it for chain task. Counters per session: F1 http_calls=17, verification_calls=8; F2 http_calls=21, verification_calls=10; zero retrieval/repair. Matches frozen predictions.
All arms achieve matched_correctness >= 0.80 at every band (exact-match scoring, so equals success_rate). V7 gate satisfied.

Counter distinctness (>=2/4 dimensions required): T vs COLD differs on http_calls and repair_calls (2 dimensions) for both families. T vs RETRIEVAL differs on http_calls, repair_calls, and retrieval_calls (3 dimensions) for both families. V6 and identification requirement satisfied.

Success margins at novelty >= 0.50: F1 T-COLD = 0.125, T-RETRIEVAL = 0.125; F2 T-COLD = 0.100, T-RETRIEVAL = 0.100. All >= MARGIN_FLOOR 0.05. Margins match frozen predictions (F1: 1/8=0.125, F2: 1/10=0.100).
claim_ceiling: The experiment delivers a bounded, pre-freeze, arithmetically checkable dynamic-range certificate for the SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 substrate class with families F1-RECORDS (K=8) and F2-WIDGETS (K=10). Both families certify at novelty >= 0.50 with all V1-V8 gates passing: comparators at (K-1)/K = 0.875 and 0.900 (strictly inside [0.80, 0.95)), treatment and positive control at 1.0, matched_correctness >= 0.80 everywhere, counter distinctness (2/4 and 3/4 dimensions) and success margins (0.125/0.100) exceeding the 0.05 floor, NC-MECHANISM-OFF destroying the certificate, NC-NO-LEAK clean, determinism verified. This constitutes substrate-validity evidence for C-MEAS-VALID sufficient to discharge the B2 readiness blocker IF the Director accepts this credential-free asymmetric-discovery construction class. The certificate does not generalize to other K values (though K-sweep 6..12 is arithmetically in-band), other credential-free constructions, economically-bearing carriers, or natural Web tasks. No mechanism is promoted and the flagship C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark was not run.
